void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool includes(string[] items, string text)
    for item := items[]
        if item == text
            return true
    return false

nat locate(string[] items, string text)
    for: i < #items
        if items[i] == text
            return i
    return #items

nat[] ordered_set(nat[] items)
    nat[] result := []
    for item := items.sorted()[]
        if #result == 0 or result[-1] != item
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

string index_key(nat[] items)
    return [for item := items[] then string(item)].join(",")

string sorted_alphabet(string text)
    return [for i := (nat(0):<#text)[] then text[i]].sorted().join("")

string[] series(string prefix, nat count)
    return [for i := (0:<nat(count))[] then prefix + string(i)]

string word_text(string text)
    return if text == "" then "e" else text

class Edge(nat source, nat column, nat target)
class Automaton(string kind, string[] states, string alphabet, nat start, nat[] accepting, nat[][][] cells)
    nat transition_count()
        nat result := 0
        for row := cells[]
            for targets := row[]
                result += #targets
        return result

    string summary(string name)
        return kind + " " + name + ": alphabet=" + alphabet + " states={#states} accepting={#accepting} transitions={transition_count()}"

    string set_text(nat[] indices)
        return "{{" + [for i := ordered_set(indices)[] then states[i]].join(",") + "}}"

    string list_text(nat[] indices)
        return if #indices == 0 then "none" else [for i := ordered_set(indices)[] then states[i]].join(",")

    bool accepts(nat[] indices)
        for i := indices[]
            for member := accepting[]
                if i == member
                    return true
        return false

    nat[] closure(nat[] seeds)
        seen := [for i := (nat(0):<#states)[] then false]
        nat[] pending := []
        for item := seeds[]
            if not seen[item]
                seen[item] = true
                pending = pending.append(item)
        nat cursor := 0
        while cursor < #pending
            current := pending[cursor]
            cursor += 1
            for target := cells[current][#alphabet][]
                if not seen[target]
                    seen[target] = true
                    pending = pending.append(target)
        return [for i := (nat(0):<#states)[] if seen[i] then i]

    nat[] destination(nat[] source_set, nat symbol_index)
        nat[] targets := []
        for source := source_set[]
            targets = targets.concat(cells[source][symbol_index])
        return closure(ordered_set(targets))

    nat delta(nat source, nat symbol_index)
        return cells[source][symbol_index][0]

    bool has_epsilon()
        for: i < #states
            if #cells[i][#alphabet] > 0
                return true
        return false

    nat[] reachable()
        seen := [for i := (nat(0):<#states)[] then false]
        pending := [start]
        seen[start] = true
        nat cursor := 0
        while cursor < #pending
            current := pending[cursor]
            cursor += 1
            for targets := cells[current][]
                for target := targets[]
                    if not seen[target]
                        seen[target] = true
                        pending = pending.append(target)
        return [for i := (nat(0):<#states)[] if seen[i] then i]

    nat[] live()
        nat[][] reverse_edges := [for i := (nat(0):<#states)[] then []]
        for: source < #states
            for targets := cells[source][]
                for target := targets[]
                    reverse_edges[target] = reverse_edges[target].append(source)
        seen := [for i := (nat(0):<#states)[] then false]
        pending := accepting
        for item := pending[]
            seen[item] = true
        nat cursor := 0
        while cursor < #pending
            current := pending[cursor]
            cursor += 1
            for source := reverse_edges[current][]
                if not seen[source]
                    seen[source] = true
                    pending = pending.append(source)
        return [for i := (nat(0):<#states)[] if seen[i] then i]

Automaton make_automaton(string kind, string[] names, string alphabet, nat start, nat[] final_states, Edge[] edges)
    nat[][][] cells := [for i := (nat(0):<#names)[] then [for j := (nat(0):<(nat(#alphabet) + 1))[] then []]]
    for edge := edges[]
        cells[edge.source][edge.column] = cells[edge.source][edge.column].append(edge.target)
    for: i < #names
        for: j <= #alphabet
            cells[i][j] = ordered_set(cells[i][j])
    return Automaton(kind, names, alphabet, start, ordered_set(final_states), cells)

Edge[] all_edges(Automaton machine, nat offset := 0)
    Edge[] result := []
    for: i < #machine.states
        for: j <= #machine.alphabet
            for target := machine.cells[i][j][]
                result = result.append(Edge(i + offset, j, target + offset))
    return result

class Conversion(Automaton machine, string[] details)
Conversion determinize(Automaton machine)
    subsets := [machine.closure([machine.start])]
    map<string, nat> indices
    .indices.set(index_key(subsets[0]), 0)
    Edge[] edges := []
    nat[] final_states := []
    nat cursor := 0
    while cursor < #subsets
        current := subsets[cursor]
        if machine.accepts(current)
            final_states = final_states.append(cursor)
        for: c < #machine.alphabet
            target := machine.destination(current, c)
            key := index_key(target)
            target_index := #subsets
            match indices.get(key)
                nat found
                    target_index = found
                none
                    .indices.set(key, target_index)
                    subsets = subsets.append(target)
            edges = edges.append(Edge(cursor, c, target_index))
        cursor += 1
    names := series("D", #subsets)
    details := [for i := (nat(0):<#subsets)[] then "  " + names[i] + " = " + machine.set_text(subsets[i])]
    return Conversion(make_automaton("DFA", names, machine.alphabet, 0, final_states, edges), details)

Conversion minimize_dfa(Automaton machine)
    reachable_states := machine.reachable()
    reachable_flags := [for i := (nat(0):<#machine.states)[] then false]
    for item := reachable_states[]
        reachable_flags[item] = true
    lost := [for i := (nat(0):<#machine.states)[] if not reachable_flags[i] then i]
    nat[][] blocks := []
    positive := [for i := reachable_states[] if machine.accepts([i]) then i]
    negative := [for i := reachable_states[] if not machine.accepts([i]) then i]
    if #positive > 0
        blocks = blocks.append(positive)
    if #negative > 0
        if #blocks > 0 and negative[0] < blocks[0][0]
            blocks = [negative].concat(blocks)
        else
            blocks = blocks.append(negative)
    details := ["  unreachable: " + machine.list_text(lost), "  round 0: " + [for group := blocks[] then machine.set_text(group)].join(" ")]
    nat round_number := 1
    nat[] membership := [for i := (nat(0):<#machine.states)[] then 0]
    while true
        for: i < #blocks
            for item := blocks[i][]
                membership[item] = i
        map<string, nat> signatures
        nat[][] refined := []
        for item := reachable_states[]
            signature := [membership[item]]
            for: c < #machine.alphabet
                signature = signature.append(membership[machine.delta(item, c)])
            key := index_key(signature)
            group_index := #refined
            match signatures.get(key)
                nat found
                    group_index = found
                none
                    .signatures.set(key, group_index)
                    refined = refined.append([])
            refined[group_index] = refined[group_index].append(item)
        if #refined == #blocks
            break
        blocks = refined
        details = details.append("  round {round_number}: " + [for group := blocks[] then machine.set_text(group)].join(" "))
        round_number += 1
    order := [membership[machine.start]]
    renamed := [for i := (nat(0):<#blocks)[] then #blocks]
    renamed[order[0]] = 0
    Edge[] edges := []
    nat[] final_states := []
    nat cursor := 0
    while cursor < #order
        old_group := order[cursor]
        representative := blocks[old_group][0]
        if machine.accepts([representative])
            final_states = final_states.append(cursor)
        details = details.append("  M{cursor} = " + machine.set_text(blocks[old_group]))
        for: c < #machine.alphabet
            target_group := membership[machine.delta(representative, c)]
            if renamed[target_group] == #blocks
                renamed[target_group] = #order
                order = order.append(target_group)
            edges = edges.append(Edge(cursor, c, renamed[target_group]))
        cursor += 1
    return Conversion(make_automaton("DFA", series("M", #order), machine.alphabet, 0, final_states, edges), details)

class RegexNode(string kind, symbol := "", nat[] children := [])
class RegexReader(string text)
    nat cursor := 0
    RegexNode[] nodes := []

    string next_character()
        return if cursor == #text then "" else text[cursor]

    error problem()
        return error("syntax error at {cursor + 1}")

    nat .append_node(RegexNode item)
        nodes = nodes.append(item)
        return #nodes - 1

    nat | error .atom()
        character := next_character()
        if character != "" and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789".contains(character)
            cursor += 1
            return .append_node(RegexNode("literal", character))
        if character != "("
            return problem()
        cursor += 1
        result := try .alternation()
        if next_character() != ")"
            return problem()
        cursor += 1
        return result

    nat | error .factor()
        result := try .atom()
        while next_character() != "" and "*+?".contains(next_character())
            operation := next_character()
            cursor += 1
            result = .append_node(RegexNode(operation, children = [result]))
        return result

    nat | error .concatenation()
        parts := [try .factor()]
        while next_character() != "" and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789(".contains(next_character())
            parts = parts.append(try .factor())
        return if #parts == 1 then parts[0] else .append_node(RegexNode("concat", children = parts))

    nat | error .alternation()
        parts := [try .concatenation()]
        while next_character() == "|"
            cursor += 1
            parts = parts.append(try .concatenation())
        return if #parts == 1 then parts[0] else .append_node(RegexNode("alternate", children = parts))

    nat | error .parse()
        result := try .alternation()
        if cursor != #text
            return problem()
        return result

class Fragment(nat entry, nat exit)
class Thompson(RegexNode[] nodes, string alphabet)
    nat count := 0
    Edge[] edges := []

    nat .allocate()
        result := count
        count += 1
        return result

    void .connect(nat source, nat column, nat target)
        edges = edges.append(Edge(source, column, target))

    Fragment .construct(nat root)
        item := nodes[root]
        epsilon := #alphabet
        if item.kind == "literal"
            entry := .allocate()
            exit := .allocate()
            column := epsilon
            if item.symbol != "e"
                for: i < #alphabet
                    if alphabet[i] == item.symbol
                        column = i
            .connect(entry, column, exit)
            return Fragment(entry, exit)
        if item.kind == "concat"
            first := .construct(item.children[0])
            end_state := first.exit
            for: 1 <= i < #item.children
                part := .construct(item.children[i])
                .connect(end_state, epsilon, part.entry)
                end_state = part.exit
            return Fragment(first.entry, end_state)
        entry := .allocate()
        if item.kind == "alternate"
            Fragment[] parts := []
            for child := item.children[]
                parts = parts.append(.construct(child))
            exit := .allocate()
            for part := parts[]
                .connect(entry, epsilon, part.entry)
                .connect(part.exit, epsilon, exit)
            return Fragment(entry, exit)
        inner := .construct(item.children[0])
        exit := .allocate()
        .connect(entry, epsilon, inner.entry)
        .connect(inner.exit, epsilon, exit)
        if item.kind != "?"
            .connect(inner.exit, epsilon, inner.entry)
        if item.kind != "+"
            .connect(entry, epsilon, exit)
        return Fragment(entry, exit)

class LanguageStatus(bool empty, bool infinite)
LanguageStatus language_status(Automaton machine)
    live_states := machine.live()
    useful := [for i := (nat(0):<#machine.states)[] then false]
    for item := live_states[]
        useful[item] = true
    if not useful[machine.start]
        return LanguageStatus(true, false)
    nat[] indegree := [for i := (nat(0):<#machine.states)[] then 0]
    for source := live_states[]
        for: c < #machine.alphabet
            target := machine.delta(source, c)
            if useful[target]
                indegree[target] += 1
    pending := [for item := live_states[] if indegree[item] == 0 then item]
    nat cursor := 0
    while cursor < #pending
        source := pending[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for: c < #machine.alphabet
            target := machine.delta(source, c)
            if useful[target]
                indegree[target] -= 1
                if indegree[target] == 0
                    pending = pending.append(target)
    return LanguageStatus(false, #pending != #live_states)

nat[] next_counts(Automaton machine, nat[] counts)
    nat[] result := [for i := (nat(0):<#machine.states)[] then 0]
    for: source < #machine.states
        for: c < #machine.alphabet
            result[machine.delta(source, c)] += counts[source]
    return result

nat accepted_count(Automaton machine, nat[] counts)
    nat result := 0
    for item := machine.accepting[]
        result += counts[item]
    return result

string | none smallest_word(Automaton machine)
    seen := [for i := (nat(0):<#machine.states)[] then false]
    pending := [machine.start]
    labels := [""]
    seen[machine.start] = true
    nat cursor := 0
    while cursor < #pending
        current := pending[cursor]
        label := labels[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        if machine.accepts([current])
            return label
        for: c < #machine.alphabet
            target := machine.delta(current, c)
            if not seen[target]
                seen[target] = true
                pending = pending.append(target)
                labels = labels.append(label + machine.alphabet[c])
    return none

class Pair(nat first, nat second)
string pair_key(Pair item)
    return "{item.first}:{item.second}"

Conversion product_dfa(Automaton a, Automaton b, string operation)
    pairs := [Pair(a.start, b.start)]
    map<string, nat> indices
    .indices.set(pair_key(pairs[0]), 0)
    Edge[] edges := []
    nat[] final_states := []
    string[] details := []
    nat cursor := 0
    while cursor < #pairs
        current := pairs[cursor]
        first_accepts := a.accepts([current.first])
        second_accepts := b.accepts([current.second])
        final := if operation == "UNION" then first_accepts or second_accepts else (if operation == "INTERSECT" then first_accepts and second_accepts else first_accepts and not second_accepts)
        if final
            final_states = final_states.append(cursor)
        details = details.append("  P{cursor} = (" + a.states[current.first] + "," + b.states[current.second] + ")")
        for: c < #a.alphabet
            target := Pair(a.delta(current.first, c), b.delta(current.second, c))
            key := pair_key(target)
            target_index := #pairs
            match indices.get(key)
                nat found
                    target_index = found
                none
                    .indices.set(key, target_index)
                    pairs = pairs.append(target)
            edges = edges.append(Edge(cursor, c, target_index))
        cursor += 1
    return Conversion(make_automaton("DFA", series("P", #pairs), a.alphabet, 0, final_states, edges), details)

string equivalent_text(Automaton a, Automaton b, string first_name, string second_name)
    pairs := [Pair(a.start, b.start)]
    labels := [""]
    map<string, bool> seen
    .seen.set(pair_key(pairs[0]), true)
    nat cursor := 0
    while cursor < #pairs
        current := pairs[cursor]
        label := labels[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        first_accepts := a.accepts([current.first])
        second_accepts := b.accepts([current.second])
        if first_accepts != second_accepts
            return "NOT EQUIVALENT: " + word_text(label) + " is accepted only by " + (if first_accepts then first_name else second_name)
        for: c < #a.alphabet
            target := Pair(a.delta(current.first, c), b.delta(current.second, c))
            key := pair_key(target)
            if not seen.has(key)
                .seen.set(key, true)
                pairs = pairs.append(target)
                labels = labels.append(label + a.alphabet[c])
    return "EQUIVALENT"

string synchronize(Automaton machine)
    subsets := [[for i := (nat(0):<#machine.states)[] then i]]
    labels := [""]
    map<string, bool> seen
    .seen.set(index_key(subsets[0]), true)
    nat cursor := 0
    while cursor < #subsets
        current := subsets[cursor]
        label := labels[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        if #current == 1
            return "SYNCHRONIZING " + word_text(label) + " -> " + machine.states[current[0]]
        for: c < #machine.alphabet
            target := ordered_set([for item := current[] then machine.delta(item, c)])
            key := index_key(target)
            if not seen.has(key)
                .seen.set(key, true)
                subsets = subsets.append(target)
                labels = labels.append(label + machine.alphabet[c])
    return "NOT SYNCHRONIZING"

string[] table_lines(Automaton machine)
    columns := #machine.alphabet + (if machine.kind == "NFA" and machine.has_epsilon() then 1 else 0)
    rows := [[""].concat([for c := (0:<nat(columns))[] then (if c == #machine.alphabet then "e" else machine.alphabet[c])])]
    for: i < #machine.states
        label := (if i == machine.start then "->" else "  ") + (if machine.accepts([i]) then "*" else " ") + machine.states[i]
        row := [label]
        for: nat c < columns
            targets := machine.cells[i][c]
            row = row.append(if machine.kind == "DFA" then machine.states[targets[0]] else (if #targets == 0 then "-" else machine.set_text(targets)))
        rows = rows.append(row)
    nat[] widths := [for c := (nat(0):<(nat(columns) + 1))[] then 0]
    for row := rows[]
        for: nat c <= columns
            widths[c] = if widths[c] < #row[c] then #row[c] else widths[c]
    string[] output := []
    for row := rows[]
        cells := [for c := (nat(0):<(nat(columns) + 1))[] then row[c] + " " * (widths[c] - #row[c])]
        text := cells.join("  ")
        while #text > 0 and text[#text - 1] == " "
            text = text[:<#text - 1]
        output = output.append(text)
    return output

string show_line(Automaton machine, string name)
    final_text := if #machine.accepting == 0 then "-" else [for i := machine.accepting[] then machine.states[i]].join(",")
    parts := [machine.kind, name, machine.states.join(","), machine.alphabet, machine.states[machine.start], final_text]
    for edge := all_edges(machine)[]
        symbol := if edge.column == #machine.alphabet then "e" else machine.alphabet[edge.column]
        parts = parts.append(machine.states[edge.source] + ":" + symbol + ":" + machine.states[edge.target])
    return parts.join(" ")

class Toolkit()
    string[] names := []
    Automaton[] machines := []

    string[] .register(string name, Automaton machine, string[] details := [])
        names = names.append(name)
        machines = machines.append(machine)
        return [machine.summary(name)].concat(details)

    string[] | error .define_machine(string[] arguments, string kind)
        if #arguments < 5
            return error("wrong number of arguments")
        name := arguments[0]
        if includes(names, name)
            return error(name + " already exists")
        state_names := arguments[1].split(",")
        string[] seen_states := []
        for item := state_names[]
            if includes(seen_states, item)
                return error("duplicate state " + item)
            seen_states = seen_states.append(item)
        alphabet := sorted_alphabet(arguments[2])
        start := locate(state_names, arguments[3])
        if start == #state_names
            return error("unknown state " + arguments[3])
        nat[] final_states := []
        if arguments[4] != "-"
            for item := arguments[4].split(",")[]
                index := locate(state_names, item)
                if index == #state_names
                    return error("unknown state " + item)
                for existing := final_states[]
                    if existing == index
                        return error("duplicate state " + item)
                final_states = final_states.append(index)
        Edge[] edges := []
        string[] seen_words := []
        string[] seen_pairs := []
        for: 5 <= i < #arguments
            word := arguments[i]
            parts := word.split(":")
            source := locate(state_names, parts[0])
            if source == #state_names
                return error("unknown state " + parts[0])
            symbol := parts[1]
            if symbol == "e" and kind == "DFA"
                return error("epsilon transition in DFA")
            if symbol != "e" and not alphabet.contains(symbol)
                return error("unknown symbol " + symbol)
            target := locate(state_names, parts[2])
            if target == #state_names
                return error("unknown state " + parts[2])
            if includes(seen_words, word)
                return error("duplicate transition " + word)
            key := parts[0] + ":" + symbol
            if kind == "DFA" and includes(seen_pairs, key)
                return error("conflicting transition " + word)
            seen_words = seen_words.append(word)
            seen_pairs = seen_pairs.append(key)
            column := #alphabet
            for: c < #alphabet
                if alphabet[c] == symbol
                    column = c
            edges = edges.append(Edge(source, column, target))
        if kind == "DFA"
            for item := state_names[]
                for: c < #alphabet
                    if not includes(seen_pairs, item + ":" + alphabet[c])
                        return error("missing transition " + item + ":" + alphabet[c])
        return .register(name, make_automaton(kind, state_names, alphabet, start, final_states, edges))

    string[] | error .define_regex(string[] arguments)
        if #arguments != 3
            return error("wrong number of arguments")
        name := arguments[0]
        if includes(names, name)
            return error(name + " already exists")
        alphabet := sorted_alphabet(arguments[1])
        expression := arguments[2]
        for: i < #expression
            character := expression[i]
            if character != "e" and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789".contains(character) and not alphabet.contains(character)
                return error("unknown symbol " + character)
        reader := RegexReader(expression)
        root := try .reader.parse()
        builder := Thompson(reader.nodes, alphabet)
        whole := .builder.construct(root)
        return .register(name, make_automaton("NFA", series("N", builder.count), alphabet, whole.entry, [whole.exit], builder.edges))

    string[] | error .command(string line)
        parts := line.split(" ")
        operation := parts[0]
        arguments := parts[1:]
        commands := "DFA NFA REGEX ACCEPT CLOSURE TODFA EPSFREE MINIMIZE EQUIV UNION INTERSECT DIFF COMPLEMENT REVERSE CONCAT STAR ENUM COUNT EMPTY FINITE INFO TABLE SHOW SYNC LIST DELETE".split(" ")
        if not includes(commands, operation)
            return error("unknown command " + operation)
        if operation == "DFA" or operation == "NFA"
            return try .define_machine(arguments, operation)
        if operation == "REGEX"
            return try .define_regex(arguments)
        nat expected := if operation == "LIST" then 0 else (if includes(["EMPTY", "FINITE", "INFO", "TABLE", "SHOW", "SYNC", "DELETE"], operation) then 1 else (if includes(["UNION", "INTERSECT", "DIFF", "CONCAT"], operation) then 3 else 2))
        if #arguments != expected
            return error("wrong number of arguments")
        if operation == "LIST"
            return if #names == 0 then ["(none)"] else [for i := (nat(0):<#names)[] then machines[i].summary(names[i])]
        paired := includes(["EQUIV", "UNION", "INTERSECT", "DIFF", "CONCAT"], operation)
        nat references := if paired then 2 else 1
        for: i < references
            if not includes(names, arguments[i])
                return error("unknown automaton " + arguments[i])
        creates := includes(["TODFA", "EPSFREE", "MINIMIZE", "UNION", "INTERSECT", "DIFF", "COMPLEMENT", "REVERSE", "CONCAT", "STAR"], operation)
        new_name := if creates then arguments[-1] else ""
        if creates and includes(names, new_name)
            return error(new_name + " already exists")
        needs_dfa := includes(["MINIMIZE", "COMPLEMENT", "UNION", "INTERSECT", "DIFF", "SYNC"], operation)
        if needs_dfa
            for: i < references
                if machines[locate(names, arguments[i])].kind != "DFA"
                    return error(arguments[i] + " is not a DFA")
        index := locate(names, arguments[0])
        machine := machines[index]
        other := if paired then machines[locate(names, arguments[1])] else machine
        if paired and machine.alphabet != other.alphabet
            return error("alphabets differ")
        if operation == "DELETE"
            names = names[:<index].concat(names[index + 1:])
            machines = machines[:<index].concat(machines[index + 1:])
            return ["deleted " + arguments[0]]
        if operation == "ACCEPT"
            word := if arguments[1] == "e" then "" else arguments[1]
            for: i < #word
                if not machine.alphabet.contains(word[i])
                    return error("unknown symbol " + word[i])
            current := machine.closure([machine.start])
            path := if machine.kind == "DFA" then machine.states[current[0]] else machine.set_text(current)
            for: i < #word
                nat column := 0
                for: c < #machine.alphabet
                    if machine.alphabet[c] == word[i]
                        column = c
                current = machine.destination(current, column)
                path += " -" + word[i] + "-> " + (if machine.kind == "DFA" then machine.states[current[0]] else machine.set_text(current))
            return [(if machine.accepts(current) then "ACCEPT " else "REJECT ") + path]
        if operation == "CLOSURE"
            nat[] seeds := []
            for item := arguments[1].split(",")[]
                state_index := locate(machine.states, item)
                if state_index == #machine.states
                    return error("unknown state " + item)
                seeds = seeds.append(state_index)
            return [machine.set_text(machine.closure(seeds))]
        if operation == "TODFA" or operation == "MINIMIZE"
            result := if operation == "TODFA" then determinize(machine) else minimize_dfa(machine)
            return .register(new_name, result.machine, result.details)
        if operation == "EPSFREE"
            Edge[] edges := []
            nat[] final_states := []
            for: i < #machine.states
                expanded := machine.closure([i])
                if machine.accepts(expanded)
                    final_states = final_states.append(i)
                for: c < #machine.alphabet
                    for target := machine.destination(expanded, c)[]
                        edges = edges.append(Edge(i, c, target))
            return .register(new_name, make_automaton("NFA", machine.states, machine.alphabet, machine.start, final_states, edges))
        if operation == "EQUIV"
            a := determinize(machine).machine
            b := determinize(other).machine
            return [equivalent_text(a, b, arguments[0], arguments[1])]
        if includes(["UNION", "INTERSECT", "DIFF"], operation)
            result := product_dfa(machine, other, operation)
            return .register(new_name, result.machine, result.details)
        if operation == "COMPLEMENT"
            final_states := [for i := (nat(0):<#machine.states)[] if not machine.accepts([i]) then i]
            return .register(new_name, make_automaton("DFA", machine.states, machine.alphabet, machine.start, final_states, all_edges(machine)))
        if operation == "REVERSE" or operation == "STAR" or operation == "CONCAT"
            nat offset := if operation == "CONCAT" then 0 else 1
            count := #machine.states + (if operation == "CONCAT" then #other.states else 1)
            edges := all_edges(machine, offset)
            nat[] final_states := []
            nat initial := 0
            epsilon := #machine.alphabet
            if operation == "REVERSE"
                edges = [for edge := edges[] then Edge(edge.target, edge.column, edge.source)]
                for item := machine.accepting[]
                    edges = edges.append(Edge(0, epsilon, item + 1))
                final_states = [machine.start + 1]
            if operation == "STAR"
                edges = edges.append(Edge(0, epsilon, machine.start + 1))
                final_states = [0]
                for item := machine.accepting[]
                    final_states = final_states.append(item + 1)
                    edges = edges.append(Edge(item + 1, epsilon, machine.start + 1))
            if operation == "CONCAT"
                shift := #machine.states
                edges = edges.concat(all_edges(other, shift))
                for item := machine.accepting[]
                    edges = edges.append(Edge(item, epsilon, other.start + shift))
                final_states = [for item := other.accepting[] then item + shift]
                initial = machine.start
            return .register(new_name, make_automaton("NFA", series("N", count), machine.alphabet, initial, final_states, edges))
        if operation == "SYNC"
            return [synchronize(machine)]
        if operation == "TABLE"
            return table_lines(machine)
        if operation == "SHOW"
            return [show_line(machine, arguments[0])]
        dfa := determinize(machine).machine
        if operation == "COUNT" or operation == "FINITE"
            nat limit := if operation == "COUNT" then nat(arguments[1]) else #machine.states - 1
            if operation == "FINITE" and language_status(dfa).infinite
                return ["INFINITE"]
            nat[] counts := [for i := (nat(0):<#dfa.states)[] then (if i == dfa.start then 1 else 0)]
            total := if operation == "FINITE" then accepted_count(dfa, counts) else 0
            for: i < limit
                counts = next_counts(dfa, counts)
                if operation == "FINITE"
                    total += accepted_count(dfa, counts)
            return [if operation == "COUNT" then string(accepted_count(dfa, counts)) else "FINITE {total}"]
        if operation == "ENUM"
            limit := nat(arguments[1])
            pending := [dfa.start]
            labels := [""]
            nat cursor := 0
            nat total := 0
            string[] shown := []
            while cursor < #pending
                current := pending[cursor]
                label := labels[cursor]
                cursor += 1
                if dfa.accepts([current])
                    total += 1
                    if #shown < 50
                        shown = shown.append(word_text(label))
                if #label < limit
                    for: c < #dfa.alphabet
                        pending = pending.append(dfa.delta(current, c))
                        labels = labels.append(label + dfa.alphabet[c])
            return [string(total) + (if #shown == 0 then "" else " " + shown.join(" ")) + (if total > 50 then " ..." else "")]
        if operation == "EMPTY"
            match smallest_word(dfa)
                string word
                    return ["NOT EMPTY " + word_text(word)]
                none
                    return ["EMPTY"]
        status := language_status(dfa)
        nat epsilon_count := 0
        deterministic := true
        complete := true
        for: i < #machine.states
            epsilon_count += #machine.cells[i][#machine.alphabet]
            for: c < #machine.alphabet
                if #machine.cells[i][c] > 1
                    deterministic = false
                if #machine.cells[i][c] == 0
                    complete = false
        if epsilon_count > 0
            deterministic = false
        minimal := minimize_dfa(dfa)
        return [machine.summary(arguments[0]), "  epsilon transitions: {epsilon_count}", "  reachable: " + machine.list_text(machine.reachable()), "  live: " + machine.list_text(machine.live()), "  deterministic: " + (if deterministic then "yes" else "no"), "  complete: " + (if complete then "yes" else "no"), "  language: " + (if status.empty then "empty" else (if status.infinite then "infinite" else "finite")), "  minimal DFA states: {#minimal.machine.states}"]

void read_commands()
    line := ""
    scan(&line)
    count := nat(line)
    toolkit := Toolkit()
    for: i < count
        scan(&line)
        if line[0] == "#"
            continue
        match .toolkit.command(line)
            string[] output
                for text := output[]
                    emit(text)
            error failure
                emit("error: " + failure.message)

read_commands()
